Because the declaration is checked against funding history rather than taken on trust, the harbor registry records each claim and the sonnet audit publishes every slash. Attesters sign a declaration that they hold no common funding with the identity they attest, and a later finding of common funding voids the attestation and slashes 44% of the attester's bond. That is 16 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
